name: Fast chip RAM
description: The MEGA65's 384 KB fast chip RAM. The VIC-IV and other chipset devices can use this memory directly.

name: C65 colour RAM compatibility alias
description: A flat-address alias for the first 2 KB of the VIC-IV's dedicated colour RAM.

name: Attic RAM
description: Eight MB of expansion RAM. It is slower than chip RAM and is not directly visible to VIC-IV, SID, or audio DMA.

name: VIC-IV character-set buffer
description: The 4 KB VIC character ROM/buffer region used by BASIC 65 FONT and CHARDEF.

name: VIC-IV colour RAM
description: The complete 32 KB dedicated colour/attribute RAM. COLPTR selects an offset within this fixed physical region.

name: MEGA65 normal I/O personality
description: The absolute 28-bit representation of the MEGA65 $D000–$DFFF memory-mapped I/O window.

name: VIC-II compatible registers
description: The VIC-II-compatible portion of the VIC-IV register set. Its interpretation depends on the active I/O personality.

name: VIC display control register 1
description: Legacy VIC display-control bits including raster bit 8, extended colour mode, bitmap mode, display enable, row selection, and vertical scroll.

name: Sprite enable register
description: Each bit enables the corresponding hardware sprite.

name: VIC display control register 2
description: Legacy VIC horizontal-control bits including multicolour mode, column selection, and horizontal scroll.

name: Legacy video-memory pointer
description: VIC-II-compatible screen and character pointer fields. With HOTREG enabled, writing this also updates related VIC-IV pointer registers.

name: Border colour
description: The VIC border palette index. BASIC 65 exposes this through BORDER.

name: Background colour 0
description: The primary VIC background palette index. BASIC 65 exposes this through BACKGROUND.

name: Sprite multicolour 0
description: The first shared sprite multicolour palette index.

name: Sprite multicolour 1
description: The second shared sprite multicolour palette index.

name: KEY: I/O personality selector
description: Receives two-byte unlock sequences that select C64, C65, Ethernet, or normal MEGA65 I/O visibility.

name: C65 memory and colour-RAM control
description: Contains C65 banking controls and CRAM2K, which can extend the legacy colour-RAM I/O window through $DFFF.

name: VIC-III mode register
description: Controls VIC-III-compatible modes including 80 columns, fast mode, text attributes, bitplanes, and 400-line display.

name: VIC-IV border and text-position registers
description: Fine position and border controls, including TEXTXPOS and TEXTYPOS.

name: VIC-IV mode register
description: Controls advanced VIC-IV features including alpha, fast mode, palette emulation, full-colour modes, and 16-bit character cells.

name: Sprite-height enable
description: Each bit selects programmable height for the corresponding sprite.

name: Programmable sprite height
description: Shared height used by sprites enabled through $D055.

name: 64-pixel sprite-width enable
description: Each bit selects extended width for the corresponding sprite.

name: LINESTEP
description: A 16-bit little-endian value giving the number of screen and colour RAM bytes between consecutive text rows.

name: CHRXSCL
description: Horizontal hardware scaling for text character pixels.

name: CHRYSCL
description: Vertical hardware scaling for text character pixels.

name: HOTREG and side-border width
description: Bit 7 controls propagation from legacy hot registers into VIC-IV registers; the remaining fields contribute to border configuration.

name: Display row width
description: Low bits of the number of character cells displayed per row; high bits are held in $D063.

name: SCRNPTR
description: The VIC-IV screen-memory base pointer. $D060 is the low byte, $D061 the middle byte, and $D062 the bank byte; $D063 contains additional pointer and display-width fields.

name: COLPTR
description: A 16-bit little-endian offset selecting the active base within the VIC-IV's dedicated colour RAM.

name: CHARPTR
description: The 24-bit little-endian base address from which VIC-IV fetches character glyph data.

name: SPR16EN
description: Enables full-colour mode independently for each hardware sprite.

name: SPRPTRADR
description: The VIC-IV sprite-pointer-table address, with the high register also containing the 16-bit sprite-pointer mode flag.

name: Palette-bank selection
description: Selects the palette bank mapped for CPU access, the bitmap/text palette, the sprite palette, and the alternate bitmap/text palette.

name: Mapped palette red components
description: The 256 red-component registers of the palette bank selected by MAPEDPAL in $D070.

name: Mapped palette green components
description: The 256 green-component registers of the palette bank selected by MAPEDPAL in $D070.

name: Mapped palette blue components
description: The 256 blue-component registers of the palette bank selected by MAPEDPAL in $D070.

name: SID audio register area
description: Memory-mapped register windows for the MEGA65's SID audio chips and their mirrors.

name: Legacy colour RAM I/O window
description: A C64-compatible 1 KB window onto the beginning of dedicated VIC colour RAM.

name: Extended I/O / optional colour RAM window
description: Normally contains CIA and cartridge I/O regions. With CRAM2K enabled, part of this area extends the colour-RAM window to 2 KB.
